title: Privacy policy
stubBanner: This is a short working draft. A full GDPR-style notice (PL + EN) will be published here soon. The text below honestly summarises the intended scope of processing, but it is not yet a complete legal notice.

about.title: What GameTrace is
about.body: GameTrace is a game-session journal: a Discord bot, a mobile app, and a web dashboard. The product is designed primarily for self-hosting; the official cloud (for example this install at gametrace.rscibor.dev) is a convenience / best-effort option with no SLA.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.body: On the official GameTrace host, the controller of personal data for users of that instance is the service operator (Rafał Ścibor — contact below). When you point a client at your own server (self-host), the controller for data on that instance is typically the operator of your server — we do not control other people’s privacy practices.

data.title: What data we intend to process
data.intro: On the official host we may process, among other things:
items: Discord identity (e.g. user id, username) linked to a GameTrace account — login via bot link code / OAuth; we do not store Discord passwords.
Game sessions and library (titles, times, notes, preferences, user-uploaded covers).
Profile settings (timezone, language, email/push notification preferences).
FCM device tokens (mobile push) when enabled.
Optionally voice recordings sent for transcription (e.g. to create a session) — subprocessors and retention details will appear in the full policy.

noSale.title: Sale of data
noSale.body: We do not sell your personal data. We do not build advertising profiles from your play history.

deletion.title: Account deletion
deletion.body: Coming soon: you will be able to request account deletion from app and web Settings. The account will be disabled immediately; personal data is planned to be permanently removed from the live database after a 7-day cooling-off period (time to change your mind). A public delete-account page for Google Play will ship separately. Until then, email the contact address below.

more.title: What’s next
more.body: The full policy will add, among other things: legal bases, recipients and subprocessors, transfers outside the EEA, retention periods, security measures, and the full catalogue of rights (access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, objection, complaint to a supervisory authority).
